title: Doctoral retreat and kick-off, November 2026
summary: The network meets in Finland: a doctoral retreat at Akola Manor (14–17 November), followed by the MITIME kick-off and launch symposium (18–21 November).
body:
The whole network meets in Finland in November. Doctoral candidates begin with a four-day retreat at Akola Manor in Ii (14–17 November), followed by the MITIME kick-off and launch symposium (18–21 November), with training in science communication, sustainability and research ethics.

More details and photos will follow here.
